 News › News News › School holiday tomorrow, 14 November: Are schools closed on Friday? Check state-wise updates School holiday tomorrow, 14 November: Are schools closed on Friday? Check state-wise updates
 Adhya Sarna Updated: Nov 13, 2026, 15:56 IST School holiday on November 14 Schools are likely to stay open on Friday, November 14, 2026, in most states. No nationwide holiday has been announced. Local closures are still possible due to festivities and air pollution, so parents should check their school’s notice before getting children ready for school.
 State-wise school holiday status for November 14, 2026 
 Delhi-NCR school holiday tomorrow 
 Schools in Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, Ghaziabad and Faridabad should run as usual unless local authorities or your school announce a closure. Parents with their children studying in schools near CP or areas affected by the protests must check with school authorities in the morning for any closure.
 Uttar Pradesh school holiday tomorrow 
 Schools are expected to stay open on November 14, unless otherwise specified in the Diwali holiday week. 
 District officials or schools following their own festive calendar may announce separate closures.
 Haryana school holiday tomorrow 
 No statewide holiday has been confirmed. Schools are likely to stay open unless officials issue a separate order.
 Himachal Pradesh school holiday tomorrow 
 Schools should follow their normal schedule. No statewide holiday has been confirmed.
 Bihar school holiday tomorrow 
 Schools may follow regular timings. Check your school’s official notice for last-minute changes.
 Rajasthan school holiday tomorrow 
 Schools are expected to stay open. A district administration or school may still issue its own notice.
 Uttarakhand school holiday tomorrow 
 Schools are expected to stay open. The state’s 2026 holiday calendar does not list November 14 as a public holiday.
 What should parents check before sending children to school? 
 Closures can come at short notice, especially in bad weather. Before you leave home, check:
 Your school’s WhatsApp group, SMS or app
 The school website or latest circular
 Announcements from the District Magistrate or district administration
 Notices from your state education department
 Local weather warnings
 Road and transport conditions in your area
 Tip: Many closure orders are posted in the evening, so check again before bedtime and early in the morning.
 Quick FAQs on school holiday tomorrow 
 Is there a school holiday in Delhi on November 14, 2026? 
 No school holiday has been confirmed for Delhi-NCR. Some schools, however, have moved to hybrid mode due to intense air pollution following Diwali.
 Are schools closed in UP tomorrow ? 
 Schools are expected to stay open unless the district or school announces a closure.
 When is the next big school holiday? 
 Diwali falls on November 8, 2026. Check your school’s notice for exact break dates. 
 Govardhan Puja falls on November 9, 2026 and Bhai Dooj on November 11, 2026. The next big holiday will be Chhat Puja on November 15 and 16.
 Where can I find official updates? 
 Check the school’s circulars and state education department’s website.
